title: Pinnacle · brain — red flags, expedited pathway

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Tomas, walk me through exactly what happened this morning.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: A headache hit me out of nowhere, worst of my life, and my left arm went weak for a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: A thunderclap headache with new arm weakness — that is a red flag, and we treat it as urgent.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: That is what scared me. I am on Pinnacle, do we need to wait for their approval?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: No waiting. With documented red flags this goes on the expedited pathway — I'm ordering an MRI of the brain now.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Thank you. Please make it fast.
